ÇYD · 7th Grade · Theme 2

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ece switches off her phone before studying. She gives her attention to one task rather than thinking about other things. She tries to ______ on her work.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) focus

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece switches off her phone before studying. She gives her attention to one task rather than thinking about other things.” Bu tarif “focus” kelimesine uyar; focus = odaklanmak. Diğer şıklar: install (kurmak, monte etmek), submit (teslim etmek), rearrange (yeniden düzenlemek).

2

Selin's teacher checks a project against clear criteria. She judges how well it meets the expected standard. She needs to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) assess

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin's teacher checks a project against clear criteria. She judges how well it meets the expected standard.” Bu tarif “assess” kelimesine uyar; assess = değerlendirmek. Diğer şıklar: overcome (üstesinden gelmek), simplify (basitleştirmek), repair (tamir etmek).

3

Duru's new task is difficult and tests her skills. It takes real effort to complete it. The task is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) challenge

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru's new task is difficult and tests her skills. It takes real effort to complete it.” Bu tarif “challenge” kelimesine uyar; challenge = zorluk. Diğer şıklar: disappointment (hayal kırıklığı), mutual trust (karşılıklı güven), revision (konu tekrarı, gözden geçirme).

4

Elif tries to read, but noises keep pulling her attention away. She keeps looking up instead of following the text. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) distracted

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif tries to read, but noises keep pulling her attention away. She keeps looking up instead of following the text.” Bu tarif “distracted” kelimesine uyar; distracted = dikkati dağılmış. Diğer şıklar: diverse (çeşitli), welcoming (misafirperver, sıcak), relaxed (rahatlamış).

5

Nehir believes she can give a good presentation. She trusts her ability to speak clearly and answer questions. She has ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) confidence

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir believes she can give a good presentation. She trusts her ability to speak clearly and answer questions.” Bu tarif “confidence” kelimesine uyar; confidence = öz güven. Diğer şıklar: student committee (öğrenci komitesi), strength (güçlü yön), assignment (ödev).

6

Sena feels cut off from the other students. She has little contact with them and feels outside the group. She feels ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) isolated

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena feels cut off from the other students. She has little contact with them and feels outside the group.” Bu tarif “isolated” kelimesine uyar; isolated = yalnızlaşmış. Diğer şıklar: peaceful (huzurlu), challenging (zorlayıcı), appreciated (takdir edilmiş).

7

İpek feels unsure before a performance. Her friends give her kind words that help her feel brave enough to try. They give her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) encouragement

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek feels unsure before a performance. Her friends give her kind words that help her feel brave enough to try.” Bu tarif “encouragement” kelimesine uyar; encouragement = teşvik. Diğer şıklar: disagreement (anlaşmazlık), diversity (çeşitlilik), confusion (kafa karışıklığı).

8

Eylül decides what she wants to achieve by the end of the term. This target gives her work a clear direction. It is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) goal

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül decides what she wants to achieve by the end of the term. This target gives her work a clear direction.” Bu tarif “goal” kelimesine uyar; goal = hedef. Diğer şıklar: real-life examples (gerçek yaşam örnekleri), respect (saygı), interrupting (sözünü kesme).

9

Cemre values herself as a person even when she makes a mistake. Her sense of personal worth does not depend on winning every contest. She has healthy ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) self-esteem

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre values herself as a person even when she makes a mistake. Her sense of personal worth does not depend on winning every contest.” Bu tarif “self-esteem” kelimesine uyar; self-esteem = öz saygı. Diğer şıklar: schedule (program, zaman çizelgesi), empathy (empati), name tags (isim etiketleri).

10

Melis can solve difficult puzzles. She has the skill needed to understand them and find answers. She has the ______ to solve them.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) ability

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis can solve difficult puzzles. She has the skill needed to understand them and find answers.” Bu tarif “ability” kelimesine uyar; ability = yetenek. Diğer şıklar: progress (ilerleme), enthusiasm (heves, coşku), accuracy (doğruluk, kesinlik).

11

Sıla values her classmates' opinions even when she disagrees. She listens politely and treats them with consideration. She shows ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) respect

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla values her classmates' opinions even when she disagrees. She listens politely and treats them with consideration.” Bu tarif “respect” kelimesine uyar; respect = saygı. Diğer şıklar: diary (günlük), quiet spaces (sessiz alanlar), perspective (bakış açısı).

12

Defne's class has students with different backgrounds, interests and experiences. The group includes many different kinds of people. It values ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) diversity

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne's class has students with different backgrounds, interests and experiences. The group includes many different kinds of people.” Bu tarif “diversity” kelimesine uyar; diversity = çeşitlilik. Diğer şıklar: guidance counsellor (rehber öğretmen), shelves (raflar), peer supporters (akran destekçileri).

13

Buse explains a game to a younger child several times. She stays calm and does not become annoyed when the child learns slowly. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) patient

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse explains a game to a younger child several times. She stays calm and does not become annoyed when the child learns slowly.” Bu tarif “patient” kelimesine uyar; patient = sabırlı. Diğer şıklar: comfortable (rahat), talented (yetenekli), interactive (etkileşimli).

14

İdil starts speaking before another student finishes. Her words stop the other person's turn. This behaviour is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) interrupting

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil starts speaking before another student finishes. Her words stop the other person's turn.” Bu tarif “interrupting” kelimesine uyar; interrupting = sözünü kesme. Diğer şıklar: teacher guidance (öğretmen rehberliği), deadline (son teslim tarihi), graphic organisers (grafik düzenleyiciler).

15

Zeynep looks at a problem from the teacher's point of view. This helps her understand a different way of seeing it. She considers another ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) perspective

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep looks at a problem from the teacher's point of view. This helps her understand a different way of seeing it.” Bu tarif “perspective” kelimesine uyar; perspective = bakış açısı. Diğer şıklar: empathy (empati), quiet spaces (sessiz alanlar), confidence (öz güven).

16

Mina's school trains students to help other students of a similar age. These pupils listen, offer help and direct classmates to further support. They are ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) peer supporters

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina's school trains students to help other students of a similar age. These pupils listen, offer help and direct classmates to further support.” Bu tarif “peer supporters” kelimesine uyar; peer supporters = akran destekçileri. Diğer şıklar: strength (güçlü yön), disagreement (anlaşmazlık), progress (ilerleme).

17

Pelin must hand in her project by Friday at four. Work sent after that time is late. Friday at four is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) deadline

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin must hand in her project by Friday at four. Work sent after that time is late.” Bu tarif “deadline” kelimesine uyar; deadline = son teslim tarihi. Diğer şıklar: disappointment (hayal kırıklığı), real-life examples (gerçek yaşam örnekleri), self-esteem (öz saygı).

18

Derya plans the times for her lessons, homework and club meetings. She puts them together in a timetable. This is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) schedule

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya plans the times for her lessons, homework and club meetings. She puts them together in a timetable.” Bu tarif “schedule” kelimesine uyar; schedule = program, zaman çizelgesi. Diğer şıklar: assignment (ödev), challenge (zorluk), accuracy (doğruluk, kesinlik).

19

Sena wants to show classmates how a tool works. She performs each step in front of them rather than only describing it. She chooses to ______ its use.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) demonstrate

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena wants to show classmates how a tool works. She performs each step in front of them rather than only describing it.” Bu tarif “demonstrate” kelimesine uyar; demonstrate = göstermek, uygulamalı anlatmak. Diğer şıklar: contribute (katkıda bulunmak), observe (gözlemlemek), overcome (üstesinden gelmek).

20

Eda uses charts and diagrams to arrange information. The visual layouts show links between ideas and make them easier to follow. They are ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) graphic organisers

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda uses charts and diagrams to arrange information. The visual layouts show links between ideas and make them easier to follow.” Bu tarif “graphic organisers” kelimesine uyar; graphic organisers = grafik düzenleyiciler. Diğer şıklar: confusion (kafa karışıklığı), enthusiasm (heves, coşku), shelves (raflar).

21

Cem's school provides areas with very little noise. Students can use them to concentrate without disturbance. They are ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) quiet spaces

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem's school provides areas with very little noise. Students can use them to concentrate without disturbance.” Bu tarif “quiet spaces” kelimesine uyar; quiet spaces = sessiz alanlar. Diğer şıklar: diary (günlük), encouragement (teşvik), name tags (isim etiketleri).

22

Eren's teacher explains a topic using actual everyday situations. The cases come from real experience rather than invented fantasy worlds. They are ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) real-life examples

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren's teacher explains a topic using actual everyday situations. The cases come from real experience rather than invented fantasy worlds.” Bu tarif “real-life examples” kelimesine uyar; real-life examples = gerçek yaşam örnekleri. Diğer şıklar: student committee (öğrenci komitesi), revision (konu tekrarı, gözden geçirme), teacher guidance (öğretmen rehberliği).

23

Baran's instructions are too complicated. He removes unnecessary details and uses easier words to make them simpler. He tries to ______ them.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) simplify

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran's instructions are too complicated. He removes unnecessary details and uses easier words to make them simpler.” Bu tarif “simplify” kelimesine uyar; simplify = basitleştirmek. Diğer şıklar: focus (odaklanmak), contribute (katkıda bulunmak), install (kurmak, monte etmek).

24

Tolga finds a broken chair. He fixes the damaged part so the chair works properly again. He chooses to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) repair

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga finds a broken chair. He fixes the damaged part so the chair works properly again.” Bu tarif “repair” kelimesine uyar; repair = tamir etmek. Diğer şıklar: assess (değerlendirmek), demonstrate (göstermek, uygulamalı anlatmak), submit (teslim etmek).

25

Ozan watches how students use the school library. He looks carefully and records what happens without changing the situation. He wants to ______ their behaviour.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) observe

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan watches how students use the school library. He looks carefully and records what happens without changing the situation.” Bu tarif “observe” kelimesine uyar; observe = gözlemlemek. Diğer şıklar: rearrange (yeniden düzenlemek), install (kurmak, monte etmek), contribute (katkıda bulunmak).

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Mert checks that every number in his report is correct. He wants the details to be exact and free from mistakes. He checks their ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) accuracy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert checks that every number in his report is correct. He wants the details to be exact and free from mistakes.” Bu tarif “accuracy” kelimesine uyar; accuracy = doğruluk, kesinlik. Diğer şıklar: quiet spaces (sessiz alanlar), respect (saygı), perspective (bakış açısı).

2

Bora faces a difficult problem in his project. He works hard and successfully deals with it. He manages to ______ the problem.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) overcome

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora faces a difficult problem in his project. He works hard and successfully deals with it.” Bu tarif “overcome” kelimesine uyar; overcome = üstesinden gelmek. Diğer şıklar: submit (teslim etmek), demonstrate (göstermek, uygulamalı anlatmak), install (kurmak, monte etmek).

3

Arda receives two instructions that seem to say different things. He cannot work out what he is supposed to do. He feels ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) confusion

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda receives two instructions that seem to say different things. He cannot work out what he is supposed to do.” Bu tarif “confusion” kelimesine uyar; confusion = kafa karışıklığı. Diğer şıklar: assignment (ödev), self-esteem (öz saygı), guidance counsellor (rehber öğretmen).

4

Can has far too many tasks to deal with at once. Their number and difficulty feel more than he can manage. He feels ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) overwhelmed

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can has far too many tasks to deal with at once. Their number and difficulty feel more than he can manage.” Bu tarif “overwhelmed” kelimesine uyar; overwhelmed = bunalmış. Diğer şıklar: welcoming (misafirperver, sıcak), adjusted (uyum sağlamış), comfortable (rahat).

5

Emir faces a problem and feels unable to do anything about it. He cannot see any action he can take to help himself. He feels ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) helpless

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir faces a problem and feels unable to do anything about it. He cannot see any action he can take to help himself.” Bu tarif “helpless” kelimesine uyar; helpless = çaresiz. Diğer şıklar: peaceful (huzurlu), patient (sabırlı), diverse (çeşitli).

6

Baran hopes for a place on a school team but does not get one. The result is not what he wants or expects. He feels ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) disappointment

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran hopes for a place on a school team but does not get one. The result is not what he wants or expects.” Bu tarif “disappointment” kelimesine uyar; disappointment = hayal kırıklığı. Diğer şıklar: disagreement (anlaşmazlık), mutual trust (karşılıklı güven), diary (günlük).

7

Tolga is very eager to start a new club project. His lively interest makes him want to take part immediately. He shows ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) enthusiasm

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga is very eager to start a new club project. His lively interest makes him want to take part immediately.” Bu tarif “enthusiasm” kelimesine uyar; enthusiasm = heves, coşku. Diğer şıklar: encouragement (teşvik), goal (hedef), shelves (raflar).

8

Ozan's skills improve with regular practice. He moves steadily towards his learning goals. He makes ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) progress

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan's skills improve with regular practice. He moves steadily towards his learning goals.” Bu tarif “progress” kelimesine uyar; progress = ilerleme. Diğer şıklar: name tags (isim etiketleri), real-life examples (gerçek yaşam örnekleri), ability (yetenek).

9

Yusuf finds drawing easier than most of his other school tasks. It is one of the things he does especially well. Drawing is his main ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) strength

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yusuf finds drawing easier than most of his other school tasks. It is one of the things he does especially well.” Bu tarif “strength” kelimesine uyar; strength = güçlü yön. Diğer şıklar: graphic organisers (grafik düzenleyiciler), deadline (son teslim tarihi), teacher guidance (öğretmen rehberliği).

10

Aras tries to understand how a new student feels. He imagines being in the student's situation and sees things through that person's feelings. He shows ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) empathy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aras tries to understand how a new student feels. He imagines being in the student's situation and sees things through that person's feelings.” Bu tarif “empathy” kelimesine uyar; empathy = empati. Diğer şıklar: student committee (öğrenci komitesi), challenge (zorluk), schedule (program, zaman çizelgesi).

11

Gökçe trusts Defne, and Defne trusts Gökçe too. Each believes that the other is honest and dependable. They have ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) mutual trust

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Gökçe trusts Defne, and Defne trusts Gökçe too. Each believes that the other is honest and dependable.” Bu tarif “mutual trust” kelimesine uyar; mutual trust = karşılıklı güven. Diğer şıklar: confidence (öz güven), revision (konu tekrarı, gözden geçirme), diversity (çeşitlilik).

12

Kerem's school makes sure everyone can take part. Students are included regardless of their different needs or backgrounds. The school is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) inclusive

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem's school makes sure everyone can take part. Students are included regardless of their different needs or backgrounds.” Bu tarif “inclusive” kelimesine uyar; inclusive = kapsayıcı. Diğer şıklar: challenging (zorlayıcı), relaxed (rahatlamış), talented (yetenekli).

13

Deniz's group needs ideas for a project. He offers useful suggestions that help the shared work. He wants to ______ to the discussion.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) contribute

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Deniz's group needs ideas for a project. He offers useful suggestions that help the shared work.” Bu tarif “contribute” kelimesine uyar; contribute = katkıda bulunmak. Diğer şıklar: repair (tamir etmek), rearrange (yeniden düzenlemek), simplify (basitleştirmek).

14

Onur and his friend have different opinions about a plan. One wants to go ahead, but the other thinks they should stop. They have a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) disagreement

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Onur and his friend have different opinions about a plan. One wants to go ahead, but the other thinks they should stop.” Bu tarif “disagreement” kelimesine uyar; disagreement = anlaşmazlık. Diğer şıklar: peer supporters (akran destekçileri), interrupting (sözünü kesme), ability (yetenek).

15

Arda joins a small official group of pupils. They meet to represent students and discuss school matters. They form a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) student committee

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda joins a small official group of pupils. They meet to represent students and discuss school matters.” Bu tarif “student committee” kelimesine uyar; student committee = öğrenci komitesi. Diğer şıklar: quiet spaces (sessiz alanlar), accuracy (doğruluk, kesinlik), self-esteem (öz saygı).

16

Ali's teacher gives him a piece of work to complete at home. He must finish it and hand it in next week. It is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) assignment

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali's teacher gives him a piece of work to complete at home. He must finish it and hand it in next week.” Bu tarif “assignment” kelimesine uyar; assignment = ödev. Diğer şıklar: challenge (zorluk), goal (hedef), real-life examples (gerçek yaşam örnekleri).

17

Efe finishes his report and checks it carefully. He sends the completed work to his teacher for marking. He chooses to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) submit

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Efe finishes his report and checks it carefully. He sends the completed work to his teacher for marking.” Bu tarif “submit” kelimesine uyar; submit = teslim etmek. Diğer şıklar: focus (odaklanmak), observe (gözlemlemek), assess (değerlendirmek).

18

Berk writes dated notes about his personal experiences and feelings. He keeps these daily entries in a private book. It is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) diary

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berk writes dated notes about his personal experiences and feelings. He keeps these daily entries in a private book.” Bu tarif “diary” kelimesine uyar; diary = günlük. Diğer şıklar: schedule (program, zaman çizelgesi), respect (saygı), enthusiasm (heves, coşku).

19

Burak studies old lesson topics again before a test. He checks the main points and refreshes his memory. He does some ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) revision

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Burak studies old lesson topics again before a test. He checks the main points and refreshes his memory.” Bu tarif “revision” kelimesine uyar; revision = konu tekrarı, gözden geçirme. 20

Tuna wants help with a personal school problem. He visits the staff member who offers students advice and emotional support. This person is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) guidance counsellor

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna wants help with a personal school problem. Diğer şıklar: diversity (çeşitlilik), disappointment (hayal kırıklığı), confidence (öz güven).

21

Aylin meets students at a school event. Each person wears a small label showing their name. These labels are ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) name tags

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aylin meets students at a school event. Each person wears a small label showing their name.” Bu tarif “name tags” kelimesine uyar; name tags = isim etiketleri. Diğer şıklar: interrupting (sözünü kesme), deadline (son teslim tarihi), empathy (empati).

22

Nehir needs help planning a difficult task. Her teacher gives directions and advice about how to proceed. Nehir benefits from ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) teacher guidance

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir needs help planning a difficult task. Her teacher gives directions and advice about how to proceed.” Bu tarif “teacher guidance” kelimesine uyar; teacher guidance = öğretmen rehberliği. Diğer şıklar: graphic organisers (grafik düzenleyiciler), progress (ilerleme), strength (güçlü yön).

23

İpek changes the positions of the desks in her classroom. She puts the same furniture into a different layout. She decides to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) rearrange

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek changes the positions of the desks in her classroom. She puts the same furniture into a different layout.” Bu tarif “rearrange” kelimesine uyar; rearrange = yeniden düzenlemek. Diğer şıklar: focus (odaklanmak), observe (gözlemlemek), simplify (basitleştirmek).

Eylül has a new printer that is not ready to use. She sets it up and connects the necessary parts and software. She needs to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) install

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül has a new printer that is not ready to use. Cemre puts books on several long flat surfaces fixed to a wall. These surfaces hold the books in neat rows. They are ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) shelves

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre puts books on several long flat surfaces fixed to a wall. These surfaces hold the books in neat rows.” Bu tarif “shelves” kelimesine uyar; shelves = raflar. Diğer şıklar: encouragement (teşvik), confusion (kafa karışıklığı), goal (hedef).

3Vocabulary Quiz 50 · Choose the correct Turkish meaning of each word. (Her kelimenin doğru Türkçe anlamını seçiniz.)
